title: Creamy Peanut-Tofu Stir-Fry
steps: Press tofu 15-20 min, cube it
Make sauce: whisk peanut butter, tamari, miso, sriracha, vinegar, water
Pan-sear tofu until golden, set aside
Stir-fry peppers 2-3 min, add spinach and sprouts
Return tofu, pour sauce over, toss and cook 1 min
Serve with rice

title: Low-FODMAP Chickpea Curry
steps: Toast cumin, cardamom, coriander seeds in oil 1-2 min
Add ginger, cook 30 sec, then add ground spices
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, bring to simmer
Add chickpeas, cauliflower, peppers
Simmer 12-15 min until cauliflower is tender
Adjust seasoning and serve with rice

title: Cast Iron Bibimbap
steps: Press tofu 10-15 min, cut into cubes
Cook spinach, carrots, mushrooms separately, keep separate
Pan-sear tofu until golden on 2-3 sides
Heat cast iron, add sesame oil and spread rice evenly
Let rice crisp on bottom for 2-3 minutes
Arrange vegetables and tofu on hot rice
Dollop gochujang in center, sprinkle sesame seeds
Keep on heat 1-2 more minutes to crisp bottom
Mix everything together and eat from the skillet

title: Tofu Vindaloo (Brutally Spicy)
steps: Toast cumin, coriander, fenugreek, red pepper flakes 1-2 min
Add ginger and ground spices, stir 30-45 sec
Deglaze with vinegar, add tomatoes and coconut milk
Add poblanos and squash, simmer 5 min
Add cabbage, simmer 3-4 more minutes
Add minced fresh peppers, taste and adjust heat
Simmer 2-3 min more, fold in deep-fried tofu

title: Vegan Hot Pot
steps: Bring stock, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil to boil in hot pot
Reduce to gentle simmer
Arrange all vegetables and tofu on platter
Cook rice noodles separately, divide into bowls
Each person adds items to simmering broth to cook
Harder items cook 2-3 min, leafy greens 30 seconds
Dip in sesame oil or chili oil mixtures
Continue adding from platter as you eat
Sip remaining broth at the end

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Toast cumin, cardamom, coriander seeds in oil 1-2 min
Add ginger, cook 30 sec, then add ground spices
Brown chicken 4-5 min over medium-high heat
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, bring to simmer
Simmer 12-15 min until chicken is cooked through
Sauce should thicken slightly
Serve with rice

title: Instant Pot Chicken Masala
steps: SAUTE: toast cumin, coriander, cardamom in oil
Add ginger and ground spices, stir 30 sec
Brown chicken 3-4 min, stirring occasionally
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, scrape bottom
Close lid, PRESSURE COOK high for 6 minutes
Quick release pressure
Optional: SAUTE to reduce sauce 2-3 min
Serve with rice

title: Grilled Salmon with Lemon & Herbs
steps: Pat salmon dry, brush with olive oil
Season with salt, pepper, dill, thyme
Heat grill to medium-high
Grill salmon 5-6 min per side, skin-side down first
Drizzle with lemon juice
Top with fresh herbs and lemon slices
Serve with roasted vegetables

title: Egg Fried Rice with Vegetables
steps: Heat sesame oil in wok over medium-high heat
Add carrots, peppers, peas, stir-fry 2 min
Push vegetables to side, scramble eggs in open space
Add cold rice, break up clumps, toss everything
Add tamari and white pepper, toss well
Add bok choy, cook 1-2 min until wilted
Top with sesame seeds and serve

title: Shrimp Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
steps: Heat wok over high heat, add sesame oil
Stir-fry shrimp until pink 2-3 min, remove
Add bok choy and mushrooms, stir-fry 2-3 min
Add ginger, cook 30 sec
Return shrimp, add soy sauce, vinegar, chili oil
Stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken
Cook 1 minute, top with sesame seeds
Serve with rice

title: Baked Cod with Herb Crust
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F
Mix panko, parsley, basil, lemon zest, salt, pepper
Place cod on oiled baking sheet
Top each fillet with herb mixture
Drizzle with olive oil
Bake 12-15 min until fish flakes easily
Serve with lemon wedges and roasted vegetables

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
steps: Spiralize zucchini into noodle form
Blend basil, olive oil, nuts, lemon, yeast
Season pesto with salt and pepper
Toss zucchini noodles with pesto
Top with halved cherry tomatoes
Serve immediately or lightly warm

title: Roasted Chicken with Herbs
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F
Pat chicken dry, brush with olive oil
Season inside and outside with salt, pepper
Stuff cavity with rosemary, thyme, lemon
Place on roasting pan with vegetables
Roast 1 hour 15 min until golden and cooked through
Rest 10 minutes, carve and serve

title: Thai-Inspired Green Curry
steps: Heat 2 tbsp coconut milk in pot, add curry paste
Cook 1-2 min until fragrant
Add remaining coconut milk and stock, bring to simmer
Add peppers and zucchini, simmer 5 min
Add mushrooms and bok choy, simmer 3-4 min
Add tofu, tamari, lime juice
Simmer 2 more minutes
Stir in fresh basil, serve with rice

title: Beef Stir-Fry
steps: Heat wok over high heat, add sesame oil
Stir-fry beef 3-4 min until browned, remove
Add broccoli and carrots, stir-fry 3-4 min
Add peppers, stir-fry 2 min
Add ginger, cook 30 sec
Return beef, add tamari, vinegar, sriracha
Toss everything together for 1 minute
Top with sesame seeds, serve with rice

title: Quinoa Salad with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Toss zucchini and peppers with olive oil
Roast at 400°F for 20 min until tender
Cool slightly, combine with cooked quinoa
Add tomatoes and cucumber
Whisk lemon juice with 1 tbsp olive oil
Dress salad, toss in parsley, season with salt/pepper
Serve at room temperature or chilled

title: Pan-Seared Halibut
steps: Pat halibut dry, season with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil in skillet over medium-high heat
Pan-sear halibut 4-5 min per side until cooked
Transfer to plate
Drizzle with lemon juice, top with dill and capers
In same pan, saute asparagus 3-4 min
Serve halibut with asparagus

title: Ginger-Turmeric Rice Bowl
steps: Heat sesame oil, cook ginger and turmeric 30 sec
Add carrots, peppers, snap peas, stir-fry 5-7 min
Stir in cooked rice, tamari, lime juice
Top with fried tofu and sesame seeds
Serve warm

title: Pad Thai with Shrimp (Spicy)
steps: Cook rice noodles, drain and set aside
Heat sesame oil over high heat
Stir-fry shrimp until pink 2-3 min, remove
Add red pepper flakes and fresh Thai peppers
Add peppers and carrots, stir-fry 2-3 min
Return noodles and shrimp
Pour lime juice, fish sauce, sugar over everything
Toss vigorously for 2 minutes
Top with bean sprouts, peanuts, cilantro
Serve with lime wedges

title: Tom Yum Shrimp Soup (Very Spicy)
steps: Bring stock to boil with ginger, lemongrass, Thai peppers
Add red pepper flakes, simmer 5 minutes
Add tomatoes, peppers, mushrooms
Add shrimp, simmer 3-4 min until cooked
Remove from heat, add lime juice and fish sauce
Taste and adjust spice/sour balance
Stir in coconut milk if desired
Ladle into bowls, top with cilantro

title: Panang Curry (Spicy)
steps: Heat 2 tbsp coconut milk in pot, add curry paste
Cook 1-2 min until fragrant
Add remaining coconut milk and stock
Add tofu and vegetables, simmer 12-15 min
Stir in lime juice, tamari, palm sugar
Cook 2 more minutes
Stir in fresh basil and peanuts
Serve over rice

title: Pad Krapow Beef (Spicy Basil Beef)
steps: Heat sesame oil over high heat
Add ginger and red pepper flakes, cook 30 sec
Add ground beef, break apart and cook until browned
Add bell peppers, stir-fry 2-3 min
Add tamari, lime juice, palm sugar, fresh Thai peppers
Toss in fresh Thai basil just before finishing
Serve over jasmine rice with a fried egg on top

title: Som Tam (Green Papaya Salad)
steps: In a bowl, combine lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar
Add fresh Thai peppers and red pepper flakes
Add shredded papaya and long beans
Pound gently with mortar and pestle or toss
Add cherry tomatoes, toss gently
Top with crushed peanuts and dried shrimp
Serve immediately

title: Sambar (Spicy Lentil Stew)
steps: Rinse lentils and cook in stock until soft 20 min
Heat coconut oil, toast whole spices until fragrant
Add dried chilies, cook 30 sec
Add ginger, turmeric, chili powder
Add to cooked lentils with tomatoes
Add carrots and zucchini, simmer 10-12 min
Add spinach and curry leaves, cook 2 min more
Serve with rice or bread

title: Tandoori Fish (Spicy)
steps: Mix yogurt with all spices and lime juice
Season fish fillets with salt
Coat with yogurt marinade
Marinate 30 minutes or longer
Heat olive oil in skillet over medium-high
Pan-sear fish 5-6 min per side until cooked
Serve with lime wedges and vegetables

title: Chana Masala (Spicy Chickpea Curry)
steps: Heat coconut oil, toast cumin and coriander seeds
Add ginger and ground spices, stir 30-45 sec
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, bring to simmer
Add chickpeas and spinach
Simmer 15-20 min, stir in lime juice
Taste and adjust seasoning
Serve with rice or bread

title: Okonomiyaki (Savory Spicy Pancake)
steps: Mix flour, eggs, water into batter
Fold in cabbage, carrots, mushrooms
Heat sesame oil in skillet over medium heat
Pour batter, cook 5-6 min until golden
Flip carefully, cook other side 4-5 min
Top with mayo and sriracha crisscross
Top with bonito flakes and sesame seeds
Serve hot

title: Yakitori (Spicy Grilled Chicken Skewers)
steps: Soak bamboo skewers in water 30 min
Mix tamari, mirin, sake, ginger, chili powder, sriracha
Alternate chicken and peppers on skewers
Heat grill or grill pan to high heat
Brush skewers with glaze
Grill 3-4 min per side, basting with glaze
Top with sesame seeds and serve

title: Miso Ramen (Spicy Broth)
steps: Bring stock to boil with ginger, red pepper flakes
Whisk in miso paste, tamari, sesame oil
Add mushrooms and bok choy, simmer 5 min
Cook ramen noodles separately according to package
Divide noodles between bowls
Ladle hot broth over noodles
Top with soft-boiled eggs, green onions, sesame seeds
Drizzle chili oil over top

title: Gyudon (Spicy Beef Rice Bowl)
steps: Heat sesame oil in large skillet over medium-high
Add onions and carrots, cook 2 minutes
Add beef, break apart and cook until browned
Add mushrooms, tamari, mirin, ginger, sriracha
Simmer 3-4 minutes until beef is cooked
Divide rice into bowls
Top each with beef mixture
Slide raw egg on top (it will cook in the heat)
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve

title: Mapo Tofu (Spicy Numbing Tofu)
steps: Heat sesame oil over medium heat
Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, cook 30 sec
Add ginger and chili oil, cook 30 sec more
Gently add tofu cubes
Add tamari, vinegar, garlic oil
Simmer gently 5 minutes
Stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken
Cook 1-2 minutes more
Top with bell peppers and green onions
Serve over rice

title: Kung Pao Chicken (Spicy)
steps: Heat wok over high heat, add sesame oil
Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, cook 30 sec
Add ginger, cook another 30 sec
Add chicken, stir-fry until cooked through 5-6 min
Add peppers and water chestnuts, stir-fry 2 min
Add tamari, vinegar, sugar
Stir in peanuts
Toss everything together
Serve immediately with rice

title: Dan Dan Noodles (Spicy Sesame)
steps: Cook noodles according to package, drain
In a bowl, whisk sesame paste, chili oil, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil
Add Sichuan peppercorns, dried chilies, ginger
Stir-fry peppers and bok choy in wok 2 minutes
Add bean sprouts, cook 1 minute more
Divide noodles into bowls
Top with vegetables
Pour sauce over and toss well
Serve immediately

title: Chongqing Chicken (La Zi Chicken)
steps: Heat wok over high heat, add sesame oil
Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, cook 1 minute
Add ginger, cook 30 sec
Add chicken, stir-fry until cooked 5-6 minutes
Add peppers, cook 2 minutes
Add tamari, vinegar, chili oil, sugar
Stir in cashews
Cook 1 more minute
Serve immediately with rice

title: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
steps: Heat sesame oil in pot over medium heat
Add gochujang and ginger, cook 1-2 minutes
Add water/stock, bring to simmer
Add rice cakes, stir well
Add peppers and mushrooms
Simmer 10-12 minutes until rice cakes soften
Add sugar and tamari to taste
Top with green onions and sesame seeds
Serve hot

title: Bulgogi (Spicy Marinated Beef)
steps: Mix tamari, mirin, gochugaru, ginger, sesame oil
Marinate beef 15-20 minutes
Heat a large skillet or grill pan to high heat
Cook beef in batches until browned and cooked 3-4 min
In same pan, cook peppers, mushrooms, carrots 3-4 min
Return beef to pan
Toss everything together
Serve over rice, top with sesame seeds

title: Dakgangjeong (Spicy Crispy Chicken)
steps: Coat chicken pieces with cornstarch
Heat oil in deep pan or wok to 350°F
Fry chicken in batches until golden and crispy 6-8 min
Drain on paper towels
Mix tamari, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, ginger, gochugaru in bowl
In same pan or wok (drained of oil), add chicken
Pour sauce over chicken, toss quickly to coat 1-2 min
Top with sesame seeds and green onions
Serve hot

title: Kimchi Fried Rice (Spicy)
steps: Heat sesame oil in wok or large skillet
Add carrots and mushrooms, stir-fry 2 minutes
Push to side, scramble eggs in open space
Add cold rice, break up clumps, toss with eggs
Add kimchi, tamari, gochujang, gochugaru
Toss everything together 2-3 minutes
Top with sesame seeds and green onions
Serve hot

title: Rendang Chicken (Spicy Coconut)
steps: Heat coconut oil, toast cumin and coriander seeds
Add ginger and fresh Thai peppers, cook 1 minute
Add turmeric and red pepper flakes
Add chicken, stir-fry 5 minutes
Add coconut milk and bay leaves
Simmer 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally
Chicken should be very tender and sauce reduced
Stir in lime juice and palm sugar
Taste and adjust seasoning
Serve with rice

title: Gado-Gado (Spicy Vegetable Salad)
steps: Blanch or lightly cook cabbage and carrots
Cool vegetables
In a bowl, mix peanut butter, lime juice, tamari, palm sugar
Add red pepper flakes, fresh Thai peppers, sesame oil, water
Stir until smooth sauce consistency
Arrange all vegetables on a platter
Top with fried tofu cubes
Pour peanut sauce over everything
Serve immediately

title: Satay with Spicy Peanut Sauce
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water 30 min
Alternate tofu and peppers on skewers
Mix peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice, tamari, palm sugar
Add red pepper flakes and ginger
Heat grill or grill pan to medium-high
Brush skewers with peanut sauce
Grill 3-4 min per side, basting with sauce
Serve with extra sauce for dipping

title: Chamorro Red Rice with Chicken
steps: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat
Add chicken, cook 5 minutes until lightly browned
Add rice, stir to coat with oil, cook 2 minutes
Add tomato sauce, red pepper flakes, ginger
Stir well, cook 1 minute more
Add chicken stock, bring to boil
Reduce heat to low, cover
Simmer 15-20 minutes until rice is tender
Stir in carrots, peppers, peas in last 5 minutes
Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: BBQ Chicken Skewers (Chamorro Style)
steps: Soak wooden skewers in water 30 min
Mix BBQ sauce, sesame oil, tamari, lime juice, honey, red pepper flakes, ginger
Alternate chicken and peppers on skewers
Heat grill or grill pan to medium-high
Brush skewers generously with sauce
Grill 4-5 min per side, basting with sauce frequently
Chicken should be cooked through
Rest 2 minutes before serving

title: Spicy Shrimp (Guam-Style)
steps: Heat sesame oil in large skillet over high heat
Add ginger and red pepper flakes, cook 30 sec
Add shrimp, stir-fry until starting to pink
Add bell peppers and mushrooms, continue cooking
Add lime juice, tamari, honey, fresh Thai peppers
Cook 3-4 more minutes until shrimp are fully cooked
Taste and adjust seasoning
Serve over rice

title: Sambal Oelek Stir-Fry
steps: Heat sesame oil over high heat
Stir-fry tofu until golden on 2-3 sides 4-5 min, remove
Add sambal oelek and ginger, cook 1 minute
Add peppers and carrots, stir-fry 3-4 min
Add bok choy, stir-fry 2 minutes
Return tofu, add tamari, lime juice, palm sugar
Toss everything together 1 minute
Top with sesame seeds
Serve with rice

title: Jerk Chicken

ingredients.name: scotch bonnet or habanero peppers, minced

steps: Mix olive oil, ginger, thyme, allspice, cinnamon, cayenne, red pepper flakes
Add scotch bonnet peppers, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, pepper
Coat chicken thighs with marinade
Marinate 30 minutes or longer
Heat grill or grill pan to medium-high
Grill chicken 6-7 min per side until cooked through
Add bell peppers to grill in last 5 minutes
Rest chicken 5 minutes before serving
Serve with rice and grilled peppers
